title: BNP rally in front of National Press Club on the anniversary of the 2018 election
scope: Local party-organized protest/rally with state-directed election demand
participants_original: No participant estimate in JagoNews body.
threshold_50_evidence: A contemporaneous report verifies actual gathering and multiple incoming processions but provides no crowd size. Announcement source describes intended event but cannot establish attendance.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: JagoNews reports arrivals and a rally but no attendance count. Traffic congestion and police presence are not substitutes for crowd evidence.

demands.summary: UNB announcement documents demand to cancel/re-run the 2018 election; JagoNews verifies execution of the rally.

start_date.summary: JagoNews reports the rally started at 11am on 30 December.

state_response.summary: Mild tension with police, traffic delay and police presence reported; no arrest/dispersal/force evidence in opened body.

notes: This was not coded as support for a party position alone: the announced demand was cancellation of the 2018 election and a re-election. Actual event is supported by JagoNews; the threshold remains unresolved.
open_questions: Find contemporaneous attendee estimate and end/response of 30 December rally.

title: Government Official Forum / BASA program against vandalism of Bangabandhu’s sculpture
location: Dhaka Bangabandhu International Conference Centre; related rallies/human chains reported elsewhere
scope: Government-official-led program with reported associated local rallies
organizer: Government Official Forum, coordinated by Bangladesh Administrative Service Association (BASA)
participants_original: Daily Star reports several thousand government officials at the Dhaka program; no exact count.
threshold_50_evidence: The report describes several thousand officials at the Dhaka gathering.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Daily Star reports several thousand government officials attended the Dhaka program.

demands.summary: The page reports opposition to vandalism and official speeches, but no clear call addressed to government.

start_date.summary: The program described as occurring “yesterday” in a 12 December report; start day is 11 December.

location.summary: Dhaka BICC; local human chains/rallies elsewhere are mentioned but not individually specified.

state_response.summary: No response/repression at the gathering reported; all consequence fields unknown.

notes: The action opposed sculpture vandalism and officials stated an attack on the statue was an attack on state/constitution. The opened report does not clearly show the gathering making a demand of Bangladesh’s government; state target is unresolved. Related anti-sculpture coverage returned HTTP 403 at the exact New Age page and is not used for body evidence.
open_questions: Review whether the officials’ demonstration was directed at state policy or was only a supportive/counter-mobilization.
Resolve event boundaries across programmes beginning around 5 December.
